precision: FP32 forwards/gradients; FP64 CE/KL reductions, representation eigendecomposition and dual solves; TF32 off
solver: Rank-8 unbiased randomized generalized Gauss-Newton sketch, refreshed every 16 attempted updates, damping 0.01; exact representation curvature added using 16 CG iterations. This is a diagnostic approximation, not an author implementation. Refresh immediately following a rejected update.
constraint: Sequential linearized original-distance constraint with interior restoration, followed by actual parent-relative distance acceptance; projected actual Adam increments for strict representation nullspace. Feasible interior-restoration steps may increase data objective at most 5% while strictly decreasing distance; logged as solver work.
soft_objective_matching: Penalty selected jointly across both solvers for each protection object; each solver's learning rate selected on E/V.
selection: Sum V broken across six tuning cases then mean E NLL; never U or combination D.
rank_threshold: 1e-10 relative to largest eigenvalue of FP64 representation covariance
hard_tolerance: 1e-10 normalized representation distance at strict zero; otherwise 1e-8 + 1e-5 * budget
notes: Shared batching accelerates independent runs. Batch wall time includes evaluation; component operation counts and padding cost are retained, and serial timings are required before claiming comparative wall-clock efficiency. Checkpoints indexed by attempts with accepted counts retained.
